4\. Holds with other causes show the playbook-owner reason 🐞 Bug ◔ Observability 
_announce_hold now always passes reason=self._owner_hold_reason(job), so every buttoned hold of
a kit that contains a playbook gets §43's "a change of the playbook is the owner's" reason. That
includes kits that _escalate_kits is about to deny for a §33 violation, and kits that
_kit_bytes_unchanged refused because the hash did not match. In those cases the human sees
Approve/Deny buttons with a wrong reason for the hold, and the real cause shows only in a separate
stop message.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description Every engine-published hold of a kit containing a playbook gets §43's reason, even when it is held or denied for a different cause (an escalation or a sha mismatch). ## Fix Focus Areas - src/hands/playbook.py[2111-2140] - src/hands/playbook.py[2254-2256] ## Recommended Fix Add an optional `reason` parameter to `_announce_hold`, defaulting to None. Pass `owner_hold_reason(...)` only from `_release_kit`'s `_carries_no_playbook` branch, and from the paused-pipeline branch if §43 requires it there. Other callers then keep the gate's reason. Reuse the names `_carries_no_playbook` already read, rather than reopening the zip on the event loop. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
